headline: Khaitan & Co advises Advent International on ₹3,150 crore investment in Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services
sum: Advent International is set to invest ₹3,150 crore in Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Limited, a leading multi-speciality healthcare platform headquartered in NCR. Khaitan & Co advised Advent International on this investment.
detail: Advent International is set to invest ₹3,150 crore in Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Limited, a leading multi-speciality healthcare platform headquartered in NCR. Khaitan & Co advised Advent International on this investment. The Firm advised on all aspects of the transaction, including legal due diligence, documentation, competition law and other regulatory aspect. The core transaction team consisted of Aashutosh Sampat (Partner), Anshuman Mozumdar (Partner), Abhishek Dadoo (Partner), Nikhil Tadikonda (Senior Associate), Vivek Badkur (Senior Associate), Amogh Pareek (Senior Associate), Associates Niyati Karia, Arth Ghiya, Trisha Shetty, Ranjul Malik and Bhavya Ahlawat.
